high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "sachintendulkar," posted 23 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features two photographs and some text. Top Photograph: The top photograph shows a track and field event, likely part of the Paralympics given the Paralympic logo on the scoreboard. A male athlete wearing a blue sleeveless top and black shorts is standing on the track. He appears to be preparing for or having just completed a throw, as suggested by his posture and the presence of a discus in the air.
